paragraphs: Rabbi Abba Huna the priest, son of Rabbi Avin: Bemidbar Rabbah chapter 3. Rabbi Tanchuma, son of Rabbi Abba, said, “I asked and studied it before Rabbi Abba Huna the priest bar Avin.” In section Naso, chapter 7: Rabbi Huna the priest bar Avin, in Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachman’s name.
